paperTitle: LABORAL: A Transformational Game for Preventing Occupational Diseases via Leap Motion Hand Gesture Recognition
centralContribution: This work presents LABORAL, a transformational game developed in Unity using the Leap Motion sensor, designed to educate and train individuals, particularly computer users, in hand and wrist stretching exercises through gestural interactions to prevent occupational diseases like LER (Lesão por Esforço Repetitivo) and DORT (Distúrbio Osteomuscular Relacionado ao Trabalho). The game utilizes a sequence of 17 physiotherapist-defined hand poses, requiring players to sustain correct postures for 10 seconds via real-time gesture recognition, offering an engaging approach to upper limb health education and behavioral transformation.

content.description: LABORAL is a transformational game developed in Unity using the Leap Motion sensor to educate and train individuals in hand and wrist stretching exercises via gestural interactions. Its primary goal is to prevent occupational diseases like LER and DORT by guiding users through 17 physiotherapist-defined hand poses, requiring sustained correct postures for 10 seconds through real-time gesture recognition, promoting upper limb health and behavioral change.

units.summary: Presents LABORAL, a transformational game preventing occupational diseases vi...

content.description: The widespread informatization of workplaces leads individuals, especially IT professionals, to spend long periods performing repetitive computer movements, causing pain and impacting performance. This sedentary workload is a primary cause of occupational diseases such as LER (Repetitive Strain Injury) and DORT (Work-Related Musculoskeletal Disorder), which affect muscles, tendons, nerves, and ligaments, primarily in the upper limbs. While labor gymnastics is a proven preventive strategy, traditional methods often lack engagement. Gesture recognition sensors, like Leap Motion, are promising but face challenges in continuous, precise gesture identification, necessitating robust and engaging interactive applications for prevention.

content.caption: TAB2: Leap Motion Pose Recognition Times
content.description: Shows the individual recognition times for various hand poses by the Leap Motion sensor across 15 repetitions, presented as median values, highlighting specific poses that were more challenging to recognize.

content.caption: TAB3: Pose Sustenance Failure Analysis

content.title: Pose Sustenance Failure Analysis

content.caption: TAB4: Continuous Exercise Sequence Performance
content.description: Presents the total execution time and number of failures for five repetitions of each of the five continuous exercise sequences in LABORAL, detailing the performance of the integrated exercise routines.
content.title: Continuous Exercise Sequence Performance

content.caption: TAB5: Summary of Continuous Exercise Metrics
content.description: Summarizes the average execution time, ideal sustenance and recognition times, the difference from the ideal, and total failures for each of the five continuous exercise sequences, providing an overall performance metric of the game's exercise flow.
content.title: Summary of Continuous Exercise Metrics
